coordinateNote: Raw source coordinates. Apply the SAME transform as existing atom models; no centering, scaling, or rotation applied here.
ribbonNote: CA control points with deposited secondary assignment; carbonyl is normalized O minus C. Interpolation and ribbon width are visualization choices. Runs split at chain changes, missing residue numbers, and CA distances greater than 4.5 A.

secondaryLegend.E: beta strand or isolated beta bridge
secondaryLegend.C: coil, turn, bend, unassigned, or computed without assignment

source.note: Illustrative computed conformer from the exact stereochemical graph of PubChem CID 443376. Not an experimentally determined fold and not a binding pose. Lowest MMFF94 energy among 12 generated conformers; seed 20881. N-terminal pyroglutamate is explicitly modeled.

secondarySource.method: No experimental secondary structure assigned; all residues shown as coil
secondarySource.note: Computed teprotide conformer; do not infer an experimental fold from this ribbon.
